001package com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.combat;
002
003import com.fs.starfarer.api.combat.ShipAPI;
004
005
006public class MineStrikeStationStats extends MineStrikeStats {
007        
008        public static float MINE_RANGE_STATION = 3500;
009        
010        @Override
011        public float getMineRange(ShipAPI ship) {
012                //return MINE_RANGE_STATION;
013                if (ship == null) return MINE_RANGE_STATION;
014                return ship.getMutableStats().getSystemRangeBonus().computeEffective(MINE_RANGE_STATION);
015        }
016
017        
018}
